notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. The card's preferred upstream-sim path was not used: the gate does not install JAX, MuJoCo or the clone, and DroneReachPos-v0 is registered as a vector_entry_point, so gymnasium.make(env_id) cannot build it; the sim backend was not run. The driver serves one world of the upstream VectorEnv with a package fake (fake.py); the upstream default num_envs is 1, but num_envs can be configured larger upstream, and the fake does not reproduce the batched worlds, the fitted rotational dynamics, rotor dynamics, collisions or rendering. The fake was never compared with a JAX/MuJoCo run. The fidelity contract is F0 and its gaps say this. The environment is simulated (R0), so there is no hardware limit and no operator-required bound; the only bounds are the bridge-derived action-space values (roll/pitch/yaw +-pi/2 and collective thrust 0.051270313572899975 to 0.48 N for the default cf2x_L250 drone) and ticks (1 to max_ticks 10000). autoreset=True mirrors DroneEnv's metadata autoreset_mode NEXT_STEP (crazyflow/envs/drone_env.py:60). Warnings are the family ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.values[*]); the last is a simulator numeric array whose units the bridge does not declare. No x-cap ids are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the evidence; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed.
